changes: Residence of Lakṣmīdāsa cleared: the colophon gives Siśauṃniñā as the place of copying, not as where he lives
Notes: checked that ŚS 1772 and VS 1907 agree (both give 1850/51). Māgha kṛṣṇa 7 falls in Jan/Feb 1851, so ce_approx stays 1851

notes: The catalogue gives ŚS 1732, but the colophon clearly reads Śāka 1772 together with VS 1907. The two eras agree: 1772+78 = 1850 and 1907−57 = 1850. Māgha kṛṣṇa 7 of that year falls in Jan/Feb 1851. The village Siśauṃniñā (the reading is uncertain) is the place of copying and has not been identified. In 'lakṣmīdāsaupādhyāyaḥ', 'upādhyāya' is taken as a title.
